title: Advanced Manufacturing: From Research Roadmap To Operating Workforce
summary: Follow manufacturing research, packaging awards, metrology, factory integration, technician apprenticeships, qualification, and operating outcomes.
current_state_summary: The record now joins a peer-reviewed manufacturing roadmap to named packaging, metrology, fab, and apprenticeship rails, while production reliability and workforce outcomes remain incomplete.
current_state: The 2026 smart-manufacturing roadmap names data, integration, interpretability, reliability, safety, metrology, and scale as deployment constraints.
NIST records provide named advanced-packaging awards and a semiconductor metrology data-exchange artifact.
Phoenix records provide a project-level planning envelope, a structural Fab 3 milestone, and two technician apprenticeship cohorts.
The apprenticeship record identifies occupations, partners, funding, and active participants but not completion, credentials, retention, placement, or workforce sufficiency.
No record yet proves repeatable multi-site manufacturing performance, qualified output, sustained yield, supplier depth, or a complete operating workforce.

dependency_stack.current_state: A peer-reviewed roadmap identifies twenty-one research areas and the integration, assurance, metrology, and scale barriers between models and factories.
dependency_stack.boundary: A roadmap does not prove adoption, factory performance, commercial value, or multi-site scale.

dependency_stack.current_state: NAPMP awards and METIS name packaging functions, recipients, data exchange, and measurement work.
dependency_stack.boundary: Awards and beta artifacts do not prove completed facilities, qualified processes, external adoption, or production capacity.

dependency_stack.current_state: Phoenix records a planning envelope, a structural milestone, workforce coordination, and two technician apprenticeship cohorts.
dependency_stack.boundary: Planning, topping out, membership, and enrollment do not prove occupancy, equipment qualification, completion, retention, placement, or workforce sufficiency.

dependency_stack.current_state: The public record remains incomplete for sustained yield, reliability, qualified output, supplier capacity, and operating-workforce outcomes.
dependency_stack.boundary: Capacity claims require facility acceptance, equipment and process qualification, production data, workforce outcomes, and sustained performance.

evidence_limits: The roadmap, award, artifact, facility, and workforce records describe different stages and are not interchangeable.
Cohort counts do not establish completions, credentials, retention, placement, productivity, or labor sufficiency.
A structural milestone and planning envelope do not establish manufacturing readiness or output.
next_records: Factory-level AI integration tests, reliability evidence, safety validation, metrology adoption, and repeatable production outcomes.
NAPMP agreement, facility, equipment, staffing, access, validation, and qualified-process records.
Apprenticeship completions, credentials, retention, placement, wage, vacancy, supplier, contractor, and operating-employment evidence.
